name: VaultMesh Architect MCP Server
description: Enables governance and orchestration of VaultMesh deployments through subsystem spawning, multi-chain anchoring, threat mitigation, constitutional amendments, and LAWCHAIN governance tracking. Provides auditable tools for managing decentralized infrastructure with cryptographic proofs and alchemical phase orchestration.

DRY_RUN.description: If true, anchoring returns simulated receipts, no chain calls

VM_WORKDIR.description: To direct outputs to a specific path without changing the process CWD

BTC_RPC_URL.description: Bitcoin RPC URL (only used if DRY_RUN=false)

ETH_RPC_URL.description: Ethereum RPC URL (only used if DRY_RUN=false)

LAWCHAIN_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM.description: Ed25519 PEM for signing LAWCHAIN entries and capabilities. If absent, an ephemeral key is generated per process
